name: Governance
why: One body leads, every action has an owner, and money is set aside.

name: Heat–health warning system
why: Alerts are set at levels that harm health locally, and each level switches on named actions.

name: Populations at increased risk
why: The plan names who is most at risk and reaches them directly.

name: Communication
why: Warnings reach people without phones, in their language and format. In the Netherlands, messages asking people to help others prompted more action.

name: Health system resilience
why: Clinics and hospitals have trained staff, cooling, backup power and surge plans.

name: Reducing heat exposure
why: Cooler homes, workplaces and streets this season and for the long term, not only warnings.

name: Heat–health surveillance
why: Heat illness and excess deaths are tracked during the season, not only certified heatstroke.

name: Monitoring, evaluation and learning
why: Every action has a measure, and a review after each season changes the plan. Very few cities track this.
